scope: Verify the existing encrypted Google credential through an explicit revision-bound owner operation; no resource or agent activation.
riskAnalysis: STRICT credential refresh, owner identity, CAS integrity and cancellation boundaries. Existing vault, journal, account and client only; legacy Gmail untouched.

threatModel.assets: Google encrypted refresh token, immutable account subject, exact scopes, owner/workspace and trustworthy verification status.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Fresh authenticated owner to existing CAS; encrypted bundle to fixed token/userinfo provider endpoints; provider responses to sanitized UI metadata.
threatModel.abuseCases: Credential or scope substitution, concurrent refresh, forged expected revision, cross-workspace requests, late CAS success, lost ACK, stale runtime proof and agent escalation.
threatModel.mitigations: Atomic exact-revision consume, server-only token access, proof hash authenticated by existing AEAD, exact normalized scopes/subject/runtime/config, bounded abort compensation, no retries or operational grants.

rollback: Before reverting the feature alias, use this candidate's existing owner-only local revoke to clear its new optional proof record; retain the immutable candidate until cleanup is confirmed. Old source rejects new proof fields and cannot perform that cleanup itself. If candidate cleanup is unavailable, use a separately reviewed forward recovery rather than a blind rollback or raw database mutation. Never revoke the shared Google grant or alter legacy Gmail. Preserve audit and uncertainty.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Missing or changed scopes, wrong account, unverified identity, invalid tokens, excessive body or unsafe response fail closed.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact owner revision, consumed record, source/release/deployment/origin/configuration and proof expiry deny substitution.
negativePaths.concurrency: Actual CAS permits one refresh for the submitted revision; duplicate submissions cannot dispatch twice.
negativePaths.cancellation: Whole15second deadline begins before owner/read/consume; abort starts independent bounded2second exact-record cleanup.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker/shell is created. Running proof grants no authority and expires; stale late consume is fenced by failed-record CAS.
negativePaths.api-outage: Lost refresh or storage response remains uncertain; rotation may invalidate prior refresh token. No retry, new credential or Inbox fallback.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Existing owner, membership, workspace and CSRF controls gate exact verification input; internal agents have no credential authority.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No model call, browser VM, new allowance, financial mutation, resource read or recurring work.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Timeout compensation preserves newer consent/revoke; Redis cannot be physically cancelled and cleanup outage is reported unconfirmed.

defects.rootCause: Initial proof did not authenticate plaintext granted scopes.
defects.detectionGap: Happy-path encryption tests did not alter a valid canonical scope set after verification.
defects.regression: Sorted allowed-scope substitution fails authenticated scope-hash check.
defects.historicalPrevention: Bind exact authority-bearing scope metadata inside existing encrypted proof, not model instructions.

defects.rootCause: Initial timeout cleanup depended on eventual storage acknowledgement.
defects.detectionGap: Delayed acknowledgement tests resolved their promise and did not cover permanently lost ACK.
defects.regression: Committed final proof with never-resolving ACK is demoted before timeout return; late initial CAS loses to failure tombstone.
defects.historicalPrevention: Abort starts independent bounded compensation and late work rechecks exact record; preserve newer state.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing OAuth core, owner API and panel only; reuse AES-GCM, CAS and audit, with no new gateway or credential accessor.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing CallerCore Google client/encryption and recorded consent; fixed Google refresh/userinfo contracts and unchanged legacy Inbox.
proactiveReview.threats: Scope tamper, credential replay, forged owner, runtime drift, concurrency and false verified claims after timeout.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing provider scopes, rotated refresh loss, stalled storage, revoked owner and failed compensation preserve uncertainty.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Independent table-driven fixtures exercise initial owner/read/consume, provider, final-store lost ACK, newer consent/revoke and late CAS.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Auditor identified and verified correction of scope binding and independent cleanup defects.
proactiveReview.recovery: Exact owner recovery/revoke only; no automatic reconnect, retry, provider-wide revoke or borrowing legacy credentials.
proactiveReview.readiness: Offline tests are not live provider verification. Require STRICT, real Redis, exact READY Preview, CI/CodeQL and Browser QA before explicit owner credential check; resource tools remain disabled.
